canonical_project: China Ya'an Big Data Industrial Park / China Ya Cloud Digital Technology City
owner: Ya'an Economic Development Zone / Ya'an municipal government / park operators
notes: Official Ya'an pages describe the park as opened in 2019, with data-room infrastructure above 23 ha/230,000 m2 and rack scale reaching 30,000; earlier materials cite 4 five-star data-center buildings, 150,000+ m2 data rooms and 20,000 racks.
